title: Pro-etale scalar mate restricts to the specified projection arrow
statement:
Let $a:A\to B$ be a map of finite commutative rings and $u:T\to V$ any scheme map. Use ordinary unbounded constant-ring module derived categories on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $S_W=-\otimes^L_{A_W}B_W$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] and let $U_W$ be exact scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. The scalar adjunction $S_W\dashv U_W$ is the representative-normalized one of [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Let $\lambda_u:u_B^{-1}S_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S_Tu_A^{-1}$ be the canonical tensor inverse-image comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For $M\in D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ let $\chi_{u,M}:S_VRu_*^AM\to Ru_*^BS_TM$ be the $u_B^{-1}\dashv Ru_*^B$ adjunct [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of $S_T(\varepsilon^A_{u,M})\circ\lambda_{u,Ru_*^AM}$. Under the canonical identifications $U_WS_WN\cong N\otimes_A^LB_W$ and $U_VRu_*^B\cong Ru_*^AU_T$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], restriction of $\chi_{u,M}$ is the specified projection morphism $\pi^A_{u;M,B_V}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. In particular its counit equation is
$$\varepsilon^B_{u,S_TM}\circ u_B^{-1}(\chi_{u,M})=S_T(\varepsilon^A_{u,M})\circ\lambda_{u,Ru_*^AM}.$$
All identifications are natural and no boundedness or flatness of $a$ is assumed.

proof.text: Use the normalized scalar-to-tensor identifications of [def-sp-proetale-scalar-mate-identifications]. Their ordinary and derived existence-uniqueness helpers specialize the arbitrary ring-sheaf comparisons in [lem-sfb-derived-scalar-mate-thick-locus]; no new construction of derived tensor is required.

Transpose the B-scalar mate using [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. The constant coefficient square is supplied by [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. The resulting A-adjunct is restriction of the B-mate followed by the canonical restriction/direct-image comparison. Precompose with the inverse source tensor identification and postcompose with the direct image of the target identification, using naturality of the adjunction Hom equivalence.

The first conjunct of [lem-sp-proetale-scalar-tensor-normalization], valid for arbitrary finite coefficient rings, identifies the pullback of the inverse source comparison, the inverse restriction/pullback map, restriction of the scalar/pullback comparison and the target tensor comparison with canonical tensor pullback followed by coefficient pullback. Naturality of the target scalar/tensor comparison moves the A-counit to the first tensor factor. Functoriality of tensor commutes this first-factor counit with the second-factor coefficient map.

By [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-arrows], the projection map is the adjunct of canonical tensor pullback followed by tensor of the geometric counit with identity. Naturality in the codomain of the adjunction moves the coefficient map outside the adjunct. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence proves the requested projection equality. Mathlib mateEquiv_counit proves the second conjunct directly from the specified mate definition, with no restriction of scalars.

lean.statement: theorem proEtaleScalarMateNormalization {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (φ : A →+* B) {T V : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ V) (aV : Scheme.ProEtaleTensorModel V (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing V A)) (aT : Scheme.ProEtaleTensorModel T (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T A)) (M : Scheme.proEtaleDerivedCategory T A) : ((scalarMateDerivedTensorIso φ V aV).inv.app ((directImageConstantPush A f).obj M) ≫ (scalarMateRestriction φ V).mapDerivedCategory.map ((directImageScalarComparison φ f).app M) ≫ (scalarMateRestrictionPush φ f).hom.app ((directImageScalarExtension φ T).obj M) ≫ (directImageConstantPush A f).map ((scalarMateDerivedTensorIso φ T aT).hom.app M) = CategoryTheory.derivedProjectionFormulaMate (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f) (directImageConstantPush A f) (directImageConstantAdjunction A f) aV.tensor aT.tensor (Scheme.proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing V A) (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing T A) (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingComparison f A) aV aT) M (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (scalarMateCoefficientComplex φ V)) ≫ (directImageConstantPush A f).map (aT.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 M) (scalarMateDerivedCoefficientPullback φ f).hom))) ∧ ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback B f).map ((directImageScalarComparison φ f).app M) ≫ (directImageConstantAdjunction B f).counit.app ((directImageScalarExtension φ T).obj M) = (directImageScalarPullbackIso φ f).hom.app ((directImageConstantPush A f).obj M) ≫ (directImageScalarExtension φ T).map ((directImageConstantAdjunction A f).counit.app M))
